decision.rationale: The successful form response omits status, as nullable state is returned directly. No independent field-presence assertion resolves whether the response requirement or implementation should change.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: POST form delegates through PetData.createPet to addPet and returns the same object. README provides no status-field presence obligation; empty PetStoreTest adds none. No field-absence verdict is inferred from repeated response samples.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
